trigger: Targeted replacement review after the Rain Oncology replacement failed the frozen 20-session median dollar-volume floor.
definition: At the event date, the issuer had one meaningful active therapeutic product candidate or active therapeutic asset. Multiple indications or formulations of the same therapeutic asset still count as one asset; distinct meaningful active therapeutic candidates do not.

rows.evidence_summary: Contemporaneous SEC/issuer materials identify GH001, GH002 and GH003 as formulations of the same active therapeutic molecule, mebufotenin (5-MeO-DMT), differentiated by inhaled, injectable and intranasal administration. The frozen M7 single-asset definition explicitly permits multiple formulations of the same therapeutic asset; no distinct second active therapeutic molecule is identified in the contemporaneous pipeline materials.

The pre-event 2023 Form 10-K states that Turnstone was advancing TIDAL-01 clinically and actively developing TIDAL-02 as its next Selected-TIL therapeutic program in preclinical development. TIDAL-02 is a distinct therapeutic product program rather than only another indication or formulation of TIDAL-01, so the issuer does not meet the conservative single-asset definition at the event date.

promotion_boundary: GHRS restores one targeted single-asset reserve candidate after known Menlo 2018 and Rain investability attrition, but it counts toward the frozen >=20 quota only if it survives security identity, historical-universe, timestamp, point-in-time evidence, concentration and final deterministic cohort selection. No market outcomes were used.
